records.stemEn: A 3-year-old child has recurrent sinopulmonary infections, severe eczema, eosinophilia, markedly elevated IgE, and molluscum contagiosum. Which long-term treatment is most appropriate?
records.explanationAr: الصورة السريرية تجمع severe eczema مع recurrent infections وviral skin infection مثل molluscum مع high IgE/eosinophilia؛ المصدر يربطها بـ DOCK8 deficiency ويذكر أن HSCT هو أفضل علاج طويل المدى.
records.incorrectOptionsAr: الـprophylactic antimicrobials قد تقلل العدوى لكنها ليست العلاج الشافي؛ IVIG وحده لا يصحح combined immunodeficiency؛ cryotherapy يعالج بعض الآفات الجلدية فقط.
records.clinicalPearl: DOCK8 deficiency is associated with severe eczema, recurrent infections, high IgE/eosinophilia and prominent viral skin infections.
managementSteps: Assess infection burden and skin disease

records.stemEn: A child has recurrent infections and an elevated IgE level with a normal IgG level. What is the most likely diagnosis?
records.explanationAr: المصدر يعتبر ارتفاع IgE مع recurrent infections متوافقًا مع Hyper-IgE syndrome أكثر من selective IgA deficiency.
records.incorrectOptionsAr: Selective IgA deficiency تتميز أساسًا بانخفاض/غياب IgA مع بقاء بقية immunoglobulins عادةً طبيعية.
records.clinicalPearl: High IgE with recurrent infections should prompt consideration of a hyper-IgE disorder, but phenotype matters.

records.stemEn: A patient with selective IgA deficiency develops a severe anaphylactic reaction after IVIG. Which arm of the immune system is primarily affected?
records.explanationAr: Selective IgA deficiency هو primary humoral immunodeficiency. وقد تحدث anaphylaxis مع منتجات تحتوي IgA بسبب anti-IgA antibodies.
records.incorrectOptionsAr: المشكلة ليست defect أساسي في cellular immunity أو complement أو innate immunity.
records.clinicalPearl: Selective IgA deficiency is a humoral immunodeficiency and may be associated with reactions to IgA-containing blood products.

records.stemEn: A hospitalized child develops a severe reaction shortly after IVIG is started. Which underlying immunodeficiency is most associated with this presentation?
records.explanationAr: المصدر يربط التفاعل الشديد مع IVIG بـ selective IgA deficiency بسبب anti-IgA antibodies لدى بعض المرضى.
records.clinicalPearl: Consider selective IgA deficiency when a severe reaction occurs to an IgA-containing product.

records.stemEn: A 7-year-old child with recurrent sinopulmonary infections develops watery diarrhea and abdominal bloating. Immunology testing shows absent IgA with otherwise normal immunoglobulins. Which organism is most likely?
records.explanationAr: Selective IgA deficiency ترتبط بزيادة القابلية لـ Giardia infection، ولذلك watery diarrhea مع bloating في هذا السياق توجه نحو giardiasis.
records.incorrectOptionsAr: المصدر لا يربط C. difficile أو Shigella أو Salmonella تحديدًا بهذا immunodeficiency مثل Giardia.
records.clinicalPearl: Giardiasis is a classic gastrointestinal infection associated with selective IgA deficiency.

records.stemEn: A 2-month-old infant has oral thrush and a persistent skin rash from early infancy, raising concern for SCID. Which test is most useful initially?
records.explanationAr: عند الاشتباه في SCID نحتاج تقييم T, B, NK cell populations؛ لذلك lymphocyte subsets هي الاختبار الأنسب بين الخيارات الموجودة.
records.incorrectOptionsAr: Phagocytic testing يوجه لاضطرابات neutrophil function، وCH50 يقيّم complement pathway.
records.clinicalPearl: Persistent thrush and early severe infections should prompt urgent evaluation for combined immunodeficiency.

records.stemEn: A 6-month-old infant has chronic diarrhea, exfoliative erythroderma, hepatosplenomegaly, eosinophilia, and a high IgE level. What is the most likely diagnosis?
records.explanationAr: التركيبة الكلاسيكية هنا هي erythroderma + diarrhea + hepatosplenomegaly + eosinophilia + high IgE، والمصدر يحددها كـ Omenn syndrome، وهو form of SCID.
records.incorrectOptionsAr: Hyper-IgE وWiskott-Aldrich قد يترافقان مع eczema/infections، لكن هذا التجمع السريري في المصدر يوجه إلى Omenn syndrome.
records.clinicalPearl: Omenn syndrome is a SCID phenotype that may present with erythroderma, diarrhea, hepatosplenomegaly and eosinophilia.

records.stemEn: A child with hypocalcemia is referred to immunology because DiGeorge syndrome is suspected. Which immune abnormality is most likely?
records.explanationAr: DiGeorge syndrome يترافق مع thymic hypoplasia، لذلك المشكلة المناعية الأساسية تكون في T-cell numbers/function بدرجات متفاوتة.
records.incorrectOptionsAr: B-cell lymphopenia وneutropenia ليستا العلامة المناعية الأساسية التي يبرزها المصدر في DiGeorge syndrome.
records.clinicalPearl: DiGeorge syndrome classically links conotruncal heart disease, hypocalcemia and thymic hypoplasia.
diagnosticSteps: Assess T-cell numbers/function when clinically indicated

records.stemEn: A child has facial features and a previous cardiac surgery scar suggestive of DiGeorge syndrome. Which associated finding is most likely?
records.explanationAr: المصدر يذكر triad تقليدية في DiGeorge syndrome: conotruncal cardiac anomalies + thymic hypoplasia + hypocalcemia بسبب hypoparathyroidism.
records.clinicalPearl: Hypoparathyroidism can produce neonatal hypocalcemia in DiGeorge syndrome.
